scope: Profile-scoped job save, hide, not-interested status and append-only job notes/history

observations.action: Reproduce missing profile-scoped job tracking API before implementation
observations.target: Synthetic FIXTURE profile/job and temporary SQLite database
observations.result: FAIL as expected: read endpoint returned 404 and mutation endpoint returned 405; no source behavior was present

observations.action: Verify disposition, notes, history, profile isolation, input rejection and dismissed-job filtering
observations.target: Two synthetic profiles, canonical manual job and temporary SQLite database
observations.result: PASS: 2 integration tests; four status/note events append to audit history, reads remain profile-scoped across two profiles and a reopened store, hidden jobs are absent by default and recover with include_dismissed, and invalid writes create no events

observations.action: Exercise Save, add a private note, Hide, reload, inspect prior history and Restore in Chromium
observations.target: Synthetic FIXTURE profile and manual job, isolated loopback API and Chromium, temporary SQLite database
observations.result: PASS: connected UI/API/storage/readback after page reload; Save, Hide, Not Interested, restore, and note history are usable; browser observed no external requests and no application/submission record

observations.action: Run affected API and browser regressions
observations.result: PASS: five tracking API/browser tests and the final focused Chromium rerun pass. The browser holds the destination-profile read and checks that scheduled-search fields, fact editor fields, and answer editor fields are absent/blank before releasing it; it then confirms the destination profile reloads its own fact/answer content. Other in-memory views are not individually seeded in this browser case.

observations.target: Repository-supported Python 3.12 test environment, temporary databases, controlled fixtures and isolated Chromium
observations.result: PASS: 577 tests in 303.442 seconds on source repair c6a8b5f, before the final browser-only assertion strengthening; the strengthened tracking browser case was rerun separately and passed.

observations.result: PASS: 62 web tests; TypeScript check and Vite production build succeeded after the retry-safe UI changes.

observations.action: Resolve independent review findings on retry safety and concurrent history ordering
observations.command: Exact-candidate repair; independent final review pending
observations.target: Tracking mutations through API/UI and existing append-only audit storage
observations.result: Two original P2s are repaired: stable request IDs/deterministic event identity and serialized per-job sequence allocation are covered by retry/conflict/concurrency tests and a browser lost-response retry. A subsequent independent pass found two additional P2s (legacy rows without sequence and stale profile UI state); both are now repaired and locally tested. Fresh independent review of the next pushed final SHA is pending.

observations.action: Verify tracking upgrade-read and profile-switch isolation repairs
observations.target: Synthetic FIXTURE profiles, pre-sequence audit events and temporary SQLite store; loopback Chromium
observations.result: PASS: legacy rows without sequence remain readable. With the destination profile GET deliberately held, the browser verifies the search-name/title/remote/employment draft fields reset, switches to the Profile tab, and verifies no fact or answer editor fields are present before releasing the held response; after release, destination facts and answers load. Other application/document/resume/operation/source resets are code-reviewed but not individually seeded by this browser case. No external requests or application records were created.
